The vast range of services offered by cloud computing companies can be classified into three main types:
IaaS enables users access to raw computing resources such processing power, data storage capacity and networking; within the context of a secure data center.

PaaS provides computing and storage infrastructure plus a development platform layer with components like web servers, database management systems and software development kits for different programming languages.
SaaS provides application-level services tailored to a vast range of business needs like customer relationship management, marketing automation and business analytics.
